audience: online store owners who sell with Ecwid

useCases.title: Review the orders of a period
useCases.text: The AI searches orders by created-date range, payment or fulfillment status, coupon or customer. It reads line items and totals and sums up the period.

useCases.title: Find products that are out of stock
useCases.text: The AI searches products with the stock filter, and can narrow by keyword, SKU, category or price range. You get a list of what needs restocking.

useCases.title: Adjust the stock of a product
useCases.text: The AI changes a product's in-stock quantity by a positive or negative number, for example after a delivery. This changes live store data.

useCases.title: Update an order's status or tracking number
useCases.text: The AI sets an order's payment status, fulfillment status or tracking number. This changes live store data and may send a notice to the customer.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their orders
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by keyword, email or name, reads contact details and addresses, and lists the orders of that customer.

useCases.title: Check your discount coupons
useCases.text: The AI lists coupons and can filter by coupon code, discount type or availability.
